title: Saudi attacks on boats off Yemen's Taiz reportedly kill eight fishermen
detail: Middle East Eye's live blog reports Saudi attacks on fishing boats off Yemen's Taiz governorate killed eight fishermen. The report is unconfirmed by Saudi authorities and rests on a single outlet; casualty figures and attribution remain unverified.

media.caption: Saudi attacks on boats in Yemen's Taiz kill eight fishermen

title: Two killed by falling debris at Saudi oil facility after drone attack
detail: Saudi authorities said two people were killed by falling debris at an oil facility following a drone attack in the kingdom. The specific facility, attacker and interception details were not given in the initial report.
